# `aitbc wallet bridge status`

Check an AIT->ETH withdrawal, or aggregate ETH released over a window for day-cap reconciliation (--today / --24h, read-only).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--ait-tx-hash` | text | — | no | AIT withdrawal transaction hash. |
| `--today` | flag | `false` | no | Aggregate releases since host-local midnight on the hub (the zone named in the window's timezone field). |
| `--24h` | flag | `false` | no | Aggregate releases over the rolling 24h window (the sell day-cap basis). |
| `--hub-url` | text | — | no | Hub wallet-service base URL — bare origin, path is stripped (default: configured wallet daemon) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet bridge status
```
